start.title: A group’s scattered suggestions become one confirmed decision.
start.lede: One page, one URL. No app, no account, no store.
start.tryNowHint: You land in a live event with 4 participants and 3 venues — a decision in progress.
start.tryNowUnavailable: The demo event is not configured on this build. The steps below still describe what to look for.
start.step1Body: The top one tells you who travels farthest and why.
start.step2Body: Balanced, fastest, fairest, cheapest — the order changes.
start.step3Body: Every person’s trip, plus how certain we are about each number. Look for “estimated”.
start.step4Body: You get the final Decision Card.
start.step5Title: Open the same event in a second browser.
start.asParticipantBody: Scan the code, or install the APK. The note below explains the Play Protect prompt.
start.qrLabel: QR code for the demo invite link
start.qrUnavailable: The demo invite link is not configured on this build, so there is no code to scan.
start.inviteLinkLabel: Or open the invite link directly
start.honestyTitle: What is real and what isn’t
start.honestyRealBody: Per-person travel times for driving, walking and cycling, the fairness ranking, live vote sync, and approximate-location privacy.
start.honestyEstimatedBody: Public transit. No Iranian provider offers transit routing, so those numbers are distance-based and labelled as estimates in the app.
start.honestyMissingBody: Venue wheelchair data (no such dataset exists for Iran — we show “unknown” rather than guessing), block/report, iOS.
start.honestyBrowserBody: The 3D map is Android-only. In the browser you get the ranked list, which is the part that carries the decision.
start.apkBody: Play Protect warns about any app installed from outside the store. That warning is not a sign of a problem with this one.
